shots.content: Inside a game room, a rectangular board-game table stands between a shelving unit and the doorway, with a window along one side. A man in a yellow shirt is at the shelf-side window seat and calls the club meeting to order, a woman in a purple shirt is at the doorway-side window seat, and a woman in a red shirt is at the shelf-end seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the doorway end, looking lengthwise along the game table toward the shelving unit, with both window-side seats and the shelf-end seat in frame.

shots.content: The man in a yellow shirt instructs the woman in a purple shirt to pay attention and maintain decorum.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: The woman in a purple shirt agrees, and the man in a yellow shirt delivers the prepared presentation.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot from the shelving-unit end, looking lengthwise along the game table toward the doorway, with both window-side seats and the shelf-end seat in frame.
